name: @local/dsh-agent-soul
description: Agent Soul definitions for DSH 0.2.2 Agent Teams: soul-aware spawn and catalog on top of the base Team task board, per-teammate persona, tool permission matrix, model routing, and user-invocable slash commands from Markdown + YAML frontmatter files, editable in Settings > Agent Soul. Ships a bundled soul catalog and orchestrator doctrine, so /orchestrate works in any workspace right after installation.
